Write notes your whole team can find

Acme Notes stores every note in one shared workspace so teammates can search past decisions instead of asking again.

How it works

Step 1: Create a workspace

Add your team's email addresses and pick a workspace name.

Step 2: Write your first note

Open the editor, type a title, and press save.

Step 3: Invite your team

Send an invite link so teammates can join and start reading.

Features

Search

Search returns results from every note in the workspace, including old ones.

Version history

Every saved change is kept, so you can open an older version of a note.

Comments

Teammates can leave a comment on any paragraph and get a reply by email.

Try it

Install the CLI

curl -sSL https://acme.example/install.sh | sh
acme login
acme notes list

Run acme notes list to print every note in the workspace, and pass --since 7d to see only the last week. Plans cover teams of 5–500 people, and the free tier keeps three workspaces.
